title: What phrases should Joz LLM use when describing the product?
summary: Use precise predictive, governed and application-level terminology.
body: Preferred descriptions include 'governed predictive world model', 'hybrid symbolic-probabilistic world model', 'simulates possible futures before acting', 'predicted-versus-observed reconciliation' and 'deterministic guardrails control execution'. Use 'spatial intelligence' to mean modelling environments and relationships, not to imply a metaverse product.
